name: motif_edit_phoneme_features
description:
Set a phoneme's features. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation or archiphonemes; check best practice. Use only if a phoneme's features must change so rules and classes pick it; otherwise give a new phoneme its features when authoring it. Specify each phoneme fully (guides nasal-assimilation, archiphonemes). Stages feature values on an existing phoneme: set a value (a feature the phoneme already has takes the new value in place, one it lacks gains it) and clear features. A phoneme with no feature structure gets one. It refuses a value that does not belong to its feature, a feature both set and cleared, a clear of an absent feature and a change that alters nothing. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-edit-phoneme-features. Agent class: Draft.

set.description: Feature and value pairs to set, each an object with feature and value ids.

clear.description: Ids of features whose specification is removed.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
